_comment: Config for scripts/guard-shared-checkouts.py. Copy to ~/.claude/agent-library/shared-checkouts.json (or point $LOST_MARY_SHARED_CHECKOUTS at a file) and edit; it is read on every call, no restart. shared: checkouts several sessions use at once - branch changes (switch, checkout <ref> / -b), stash, reset --hard, rebase and clean -f are blocked there; work on a branch in your own worktree instead. frozen: trees only a deploy script may change - every git command aimed there and every Edit/Write inside is blocked. frozen_by: that deploy script (optional), named in the block message. homes (optional): {dir: branch} for a shared checkout that lives on a branch other than the default one - the one switch the guard allows there (back home, once the branch shown is merged) may then go to that branch too; such a branch also never counts as a merged base. max_worktrees (optional, default 3): `git worktree add` is held in a repository that already has that many worktrees in use (touched by git within 7 days, detached ones included; frozen and Claude-managed .claude/worktrees ones do not count). Other keys are ignored.
